item.title: Live: Artemis II Launch Day Updates
item.description:
📝 from Kennedy Space Center in Florida. The spacecraft adapter jettison fairings that enclose the service module and the launch abort system have separated from the Orion spacecraft. The SLS (Space Launch System) twin solid rocket boosters have separated.

item.title: DRAM pricing is killing the hobbyist SBC market
item.description:
📝 Used PC are also more expensive, especially with more than 4 GB of RAM. With prices going up, this limits the types of projects I take on. Lucky for Raspberry Pi, they have a thriving microcontroller ecosystem and industrial base to keep them going.

item.title: ZomboCom stolen by a hacker, sold, now replaced with AI-generated makeover
Swappa.com for GrapheneOS compatible devices – Stay Away
item.description:
📝 I tried purchasing three used phones from Swappa. After confirming for a second time with the Swappa staff that "Unlocked" devices would be bootloader unlocked, I purchased a third, "Unlocked" tagged phone from Supplytronics for $424. Before shipping, I requested they confirm the bootloader was unlocked.
🔗 Read more: https://discuss.grapheneos.org/d/33727-swappacom-for-grapheneos-compatible-devices-stay-away
